messages.subject: SVD
parts:
Hello again Stan users.

Somebody know how to do a least-squares solution of Ax=b by singular value decomposition using Stan? Something like this:

http://eigen.tuxfamily.org/dox/classEigen_1_1JacobiSVD.html

I can't use operator/ (pg. 275, stan-reference-2.4) because A has more columns than rows.

Cheers!

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: SVD
parts:
Is there a reason why you cannot use a QR decomposition? Stan has qr_R() and qr_Q() functions (that you would have to call separately) but not full SVD support.

Ben
